t: Twenty-four short unplugged computing activities for ages 5-11.
steps: Visit the Barefoot Computing site and look for Barefoot Bytes.
Check the home page, which now highlights Barefoot AI Explorers units.
Create a free Barefoot account if the site asks for one.
Pick the age band that fits your class.
Download and print the activity you want.
Try the activity with a small group first.
